//: The TypeScript config for the Vercel function in api/.
Without this, Vercel's Node builder finds no tsconfig near api/index.ts and
falls back to settings of its own, which typecheck the whole server with
different options from the ones `npm run build --workspace server` uses.
The first deploy printed two Mongoose assignability errors that no local
check could reproduce, for exactly that reason. Pointing Vercel at the same
options the repository already uses makes the build log agree with the
client/ and server/ keep their own tsconfigs and are unaffected.
